title: Scenix: Sparse-View 3D Scene Reconstruction via Executable Scene Programs
abstract: Synthesizing a structured and editable 3D indoor scene from a few uncalibrated RGB views requires more than generating high-quality individual assets: a system must infer the room structure, associate objects across incomplete observations, and recover a globally consistent spatial configuration. Previous methods mainly focus on 3D scene generation with text input or require continuous visual inputs with additional priors, \ e.g., human-annotated masks or accurate 3D layouts, which makes these methods labor demanding and hard to apply in general cases. We present \textsc{Scenix}, a sparse-view 3D scene reconstruction framework via executable scene programs, a structured representation that can be directly instantiated into editable 3D scenes. Given sparse views, \textsc{Scenix} predicts executable scene programs through perception-grounded asset instantiation and closed-loop spatial refinement. % We present \method, a framework that predicts an executable scene representation from sparse views and realizes it through perception-grounded asset instantiation and closed-loop spatial refinement. To support this task, we construct \dataset, a dataset of approximately 110,000 synthetic and real indoor scenes with multiview imagery, room structures, object-centric descriptions, and metric spatial annotations. We further introduce observation-consistent supervision that aligns each target scene with the visual evidence available in its input views. Experiments on held-out \textsc{XScene} scenes, real indoor images, and out-of-distribution SpatialGen cases evaluate structured scene prediction, object grounding, and spatial refinement.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 arXiv 2608.07012v1 全文整理；PDF 未提供可核实的 Scenix 代码仓库 URL。
analysis.ideaZh: Scenix 不从 sparse uncalibrated RGB views 直接拟合 mesh 或 radiance field，而先让 LayoutVLM 生成包含 room、objects、尺寸、姿态和关系的 executable scene program，再 grounding assets 并通过 Critic-Editor-Verify loop 修正空间布局。
methodFlow: 输入少量未标定 indoor RGB views
LayoutVLM 生成 room、entities 与 relations 的 scene program
Asset Grounder 将程序实体与跨视图证据匹配并校正 inventory
为匹配实体检索或生成 open-vocabulary 3D assets
从 canonical views 渲染场景并定位 residual spatial errors
Editor 修改 pose/scale，Verifier 检查后导出 editable scene
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 它位于 3D Reconstruction、3D Generation 与 Computational Design 的交界：目标既要解释输入，又输出可编辑的 programmatic scene 与可替换 assets。相较只产生 implicit field 或 single mesh，它更接近可继续设计和组合的 structured 3D content。
analysis.evidenceZh: 作者报告 XScene 含 110,179 cases、560,184 images（Fig. 3, p. 5）。在 OOD SpatialGen 上，full refinement 将 9B/4B 的 F1@5 从 0.244/0.234 提至 0.327/0.347，即相对提升 34.0%/48.3%（Table 4, p. 7）；single-view subset 上 9B 的 F1@5=0.355、recall=0.463、3D IoU=0.179，比较方法 F1@5 为 0.192–0.207（Table 5, p. 7）。
analysis.caveatZh: XScene 规模主要来自 InfiniGen，真实 SUN RGB-D 部分是 single-view；作者报告 OOD 仅含 48 个 SpatialGen scenes，且 raw model 对 ground-truth mean 6.3 objects 预测 12.2/14.1 个，显示明显 inventory calibration 问题。比较 baselines 的输出目标并不等价，open-vocabulary assets 的 geometry、material 与 identity fidelity 也缺少独立量化。
analysis.motivationZh: 从少量未标定 RGB views 恢复室内 scene 不只需要单个 object assets，还要推断 room structure、跨视图实体对应与全局一致 placement；依赖 camera calibration、depth 或人工 masks/layouts 的方法难以用于一般输入。
analysis.methodZh: LayoutVLM 一次性输出 observation-consistent room blueprint 与 serialized entities；Asset Grounder 匹配 visual evidence、删除 unsupported inventory、补检测对象并生成或检索 assets。系统从 canonical bird’s-eye views 渲染当前 scene，再用 bounded Critic-Editor-Verify loop 只修正 residual position、rotation 与 scale。
analysis.experimentsZh: 作者在 202 个 InfiniGen scenes、200 个 SUN RGB-D cases 与 48 个 SpatialGen OOD scenes 上评测 Qwen3.5-4B/9B LayoutVLM，指标覆盖 inventory precision/recall、center F1@5/10、matched 3D IoU 和 yaw error。作者报告 raw 9B 在 InfiniGen/SUN RGB-D/SpatialGen 的 F1@5 为 0.331/0.519/0.239；Asset Grounder 是主要增益，agent loop 继续改善 localization，但缺少 blueprint、asset generator 和 loop rounds 的细粒度消融。
analysis.insightZh: 把 reconstruction 的主表示换成 executable scene program，可先分离 structural induction 与 asset realization，再用渲染反馈做 bounded residual edits；这比端到端拟合单一几何表示更自然地支持 editability 与 object replacement。
